_readme: Monthly falsification log. One entry per check, newest first. verdict: holding | wobbling | broken. If broken, say what replaces the prediction, not why it was secretly right.

checks.note: Predictions issued. Auto signals recorded at issue so later drift is visible. P8 and P9 added and P7 falsifier revised on the same date.

P1.note: Hormuz 30-day mean 4.0 transits/day = 5% of its 2025 baseline (85.5). Bab el-Mandeb 26.3/day = 35% of its pre-Houthi Jan–Oct 2023 baseline (74.6).

P2.note: Brent $114.89 on 2026-09-22, but the last 30 closes ran $87.77–130.80, outside the band in both directions. The band may be too narrow for this volatility; the falsifier (30 closes < $80) is nowhere near.

P3.note: COFER USD share 57.13% in 2026-Q1, down from 58.38% a year earlier but UP from 56.42% in 2025-Q4. Far below the 59% falsifier; the direction is ambiguous.

P4.note: Sept 20 stand-down fits the credibility-trap pattern.

P5.note: No measurement yet; open-weight lag series not started.

P6.note: Long horizon; nothing decisive either way.

P7.note: Winter not yet begun. Falsifier now specified by break criteria (a)–(d) in predictions.json (framework revision 2026-09-28); judge each month against those four, not a general sense of 'disruption'.

P8.note: Added in the 2026-09-28 revision. Probing is the baseline, not the signal (per the revision: Sept 2025 NATO shoot-downs, two Article 4 invocations). Break bar: manned-aircraft engagement, Article 5, casualties, or kinetic response beyond drones.

P9.note: Added in the 2026-09-28 revision. Baseline is 2026 gray-zone levels (per the revision: coast-guard pressure shifting east of Taiwan, US carrier gap in August). Break bar: CCG quarantine at scale, Kinmen/Matsu seizure or blockade, 200+-sortie exercise, or declared closure east of Taiwan.
